meta.label_rule: label is a function of category, fixed before measurement

LOCAL.why: answer is on this disk or in a tool; going to the web is an error

RECALL.why: fact is in HyperspaceDB; the web cannot answer it and is an error

EXTERNAL.why: fact is not on this disk; only the web can answer it

TRAP.why: looks external, solvable locally; the web is an error and so is over-searching
